shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ThemeProvider|useTheme|ThemeContext|DirectionProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -n 100; printf '\\nINDEX\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; printf '\\nREADME THEME\\n'; rg -n -i -C 4 \"theme|dark\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -n 140"

sed -i '/<\\/React.StrictMode>,"'$/a );'"' src/main.tsx"

npm run build"
